tei:div.tei:p:
By David when he disguised his sanity before Abimelech, who drove him away and he went: I will at all times bless the Lord, His fame shall always be in my mouth. My soul glories in the Lord, let the humble hear and rejoice. Magnify the Lord with me and let us exalt His Name together. I sought the Lord, and He answered me and saved me from all my terrors. When they look to Him, they are radiant and their faces are not shamed. This man called and the Lord hears and from all his troubles did He save him. An angel of the Lord encamps around those that fear Him and rescued them. Observe and perceive that the Lord is good, fortunate the man who trusts in Him. Fear the Lord, O His holy ones, for there is no want among those that fear Him. Though whelps may hunger and starve, those that seek the Lord will not lack all that is good. Come, children, listen to me, the fear of the Lord will I teach you. Who is the man that desires life, who longs for days to see goodness? Keep your tongue from evil and your lips from speaking guile, depart from evil and do good, seek peace and pursue it. The eyes of the Lord are towards the righteous and His ears to their cry. The countenance of the Lord is against evil-doers to cut off their memory from the earth. Men cry out and the Lord
listens and He delivered them from all their troubles. The Lord is near the broken-hearted, and those whose spirit is crushed, does He save. Many are the sufferings of the righteous man but from all of them will the Lord deliver him. He guards all his bones, not one of them is broken. Evil slays the wicked; they that hate the righteous shall be found guilty. The Lord redeems the soul of His servants, and all who trust in Him shall not be found guilty.
